faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the George Greenaway Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the George Greenaway Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names George Greenaway Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to George Greenaway Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Cloverdale Catholic School (0.6 km south-east), Traditional Learning Academy Online (1.0 km south-east) and SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (1.1 km south-east).

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of George Greenaway Elementary

14 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of George Greenaway Elementary in a straight line (9 elementary, 3 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Cloverdale Catholic School, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Sunrise Ridge Elementary, 2.8 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is SD 36 Alternate Cloverdale LC (1.1 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Martha Currie Elementary (2.3 km). Other elementary schools close by: Cloverdale Catholic School (0.6 km south-east), Surrey Centre Elementary (1.3 km west), Cloverdale Traditional (1.5 km south-east), A J McLellan Elementary (1.5 km west), Don Christian Elementary (2.2 km east). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Cloverdale Catholic School, 0.6 km south-east of George Greenaway Elementary.

blocks.text: Before you offer on a home near George Greenaway Elementary

items.t: Confirm the catchment for the exact address on the Surrey school finder. A home a few blocks from George Greenaway Elementary can sit in a different catchment.
Visit on a school day at drop-off and pick-up. Traffic and parking near George Greenaway Elementary are very different at 8:30 am and 3 pm than on a Sunday viewing.
Look at Cloverdale Catholic School, the nearest other elementary school, 0.6 km south-east of George Greenaway Elementary. Compare the two when you check which school serves the address.
